name: Accelerating Dual Momentum
description: Ludlow & Hanly (2018). Scores each asset on a multi-lookback momentum measure: average of trailing 1-, 3-, and 6-month total returns (acceleration score). Monthly rebalance. Rank by score (relative momentum); apply absolute-momentum filter (score > 0); hold top 1 if passed, else route to VUTY (defensive). Equal-weight held assets. Long-only. Faster response to regime shifts than 12-month lookback, with multi-window averaging to damp whipsaw.
